Strong graphic density-gradient imaging, microscopically rippled optical texture, controlled photographic contrast. Absolutely no solid objects or materials, no smoke, fire, liquid, glass sculpture, mineral, rainbow, neon, particle dots, sparkle trails, brush strokes, pencil drawing or engravings. No text, labels, digits, time, dates, readings, UI, logo or watermark. This is fictional optical art, not actual research measurement. Asset: ONE original portrait phone wallpaper, composition1290x2796. Warm luminous chalk-ivory field. In the lower two-thirds an enormous asymmetric saddle-shaped shockfront intersects a staircase of separated wave edges; one small detached refractive iris hovers lower left. Crisp dark edges tracing invisible air, with paper-thin bright gaps between contours, amber only at a few crests. Upper third mostly quiet uniform warm ivory, middle right spacious for widgets. No objects, no horizon or landscape, no paper texture, no border. Opaque full-bleed composition, no mockup.
